inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: Describe the image you want to create, or how to edit your reference images. Plain, natural language works well.

inputs.name: referenceImages
inputs.description: Images to edit or build from (up to 10). Required if you provide a mask.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: An optional PNG that marks which parts of the first reference image to change. It uses transparency: fully transparent areas are edited, fully opaque areas are kept. Export a PNG with real transparency (don't flatten it). If you've drawn a white-on-black mask, convert the white "edit" areas to transparent first.

inputs.name: numOutputs
inputs.description: How many images to create from the same prompt (1-10).

inputs.name: quality
inputs.description: How much effort goes into the image. Higher levels look better but cost more; Auto lets the model choose.

inputs.name: background
inputs.description: Whether the background is solid (Opaque) or see-through (Transparent). Auto lets the model decide.
